_doc: Geometry-audit defects accepted EXPLICITLY, each with a date, what it does on screen, and the condition that clears it. geometry.audit.test.js and scripts/geometry-audit.mjs move a matching defect out of the red count; an exception that no longer matches any defect is itself a failure (so it is deleted, never left to rot).

exceptions.reason: The parsed PCR names no container for its reaction (step 1 'prepare' defaults to microtube, carried forward), so a 1.5 mL tube reaches the thermocycler. A 96-well block takes 0.2 mL PCR tubes only: the socket refuses it.
exceptions.effect: The tube waits on the bench beside the cycler while the lid closes and the CYCLE counter runs on an empty block — never drawn inside a well it does not fit.
exceptions.clears_when: The container vocabulary gains a 0.2 mL PCR tube (pcr_tube_0_2 is already in dimensions.json) and pcr.json is re-parsed so the reaction is assembled in one.
